Metadata.CommitMsg:
Add "General Advice" matter type with bespoke task lists

Adds a non-statutory "General Advice" matter type where staff record a
free-text description of what the matter is about, then build their own task
list with manual deadlines (no fixed exchange→settlement workflow).

- Seed: new "General Advice" type (category "advice") with a single default
  template stage "Advice & Actions" and no template tasks.
- ensureGeneralAdviceType() backfills the type onto already-seeded DBs; runs on
  every startup. Made race-safe via a UNIQUE constraint on matter_types.name +
  onConflictDoNothing, and always repairs the default stage if missing.
- instantiateMatter inserts a fallback "Tasks" stage for any stageless matter
  type, so bespoke task lists work (tasks require a stage).
- NewMatter UI hides Exchange/Settlement date fields for advice matters, never
  submits those dates (keeps deadlines manual), and rewords the description to
  "What is this matter about?".
- schema: matter_types.name is now UNIQUE; applied in dev via psql and added an
  idempotent guard to scripts/post-merge.sh (drizzle push can't add the
  constraint non-interactively on a populated table).

No OpenAPI/codegen changes (reuses existing matter/stage/task contracts).
PII enforcement unchanged: description is still server-side PII-scanned (422).

Verified: full typecheck passes; idempotent across restarts (1 type row, 1
stage, no duplicates); both apps healthy.
